learning_objective: 🎯 Let's learn how to make our drawings look like they are running, jumping, and zooming, and create super fun crafts that actually move!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: When we draw people or animals running, we bend their arms and legs. This special posture shows they are in the middle of a fun action instead of just standing still!
Action lines are tiny swooshes, dashes, or curvy strokes drawn right behind an object. They magically trick our eyes into seeing speed and zoom in a flat drawing.
Kinetic means moving! We can use simple things like paper fasteners, threads, and ice cream sticks to make cool paper puppets and toys that actually wiggle and wave.

fun_activity.title: 🎨 Make a Leaping Paper Frog!
fun_activity.instructions: Draw and cut out a frog on thick paper. Attach its legs using paper fasteners or push pins from the back so you can make it jump and dance around your room!

quick_recap: ⭐ Bending arms and legs in your drawings makes figures look alive and active.
⭐ Adding swooshy action lines helps show how fast an object is zooming.
⭐ We can build amazing kinetic crafts using simple paper, pins, and thread.
